notes: Path: doors/hub/brand/, as the review proposed (§5, pipeline 3), beside the staged doors/we-are/brand/. Here 'hub' means thekingdom.dev, not the kingdom-os-hub repository (kingdom.ai-love.cc).

One host, several looks: / is the hall (site/dashboard.html, written by bin/build-dashboard.ts), /atlas.html is the atlas (site/hub.html, written by bin/build-hub.ts), and Power Atlas and /os have looks of their own. site.html checks the hall against the kit, and pins the atlas to its own theme-color pair and scheme (icons not compared: it declares a blank data: icon), so a kit can't quietly re-dress it (review 2026-11-02: no KINGDOM palette).

Serving: the hub is staged from an allowlist, publications/hub-staging.v1.json (protocol kingdom.hub-staging/1), by bin/stage-hub.ts, not from a public folder. A kit would get contract entries mapping doors/hub/brand/kit/web/<file> to <file>, as bin/stage-doors.ts does for WE ARE. At release, run the check against the staged folder with --served; tests/stage-hub.test.ts holds the contract.

Guards: tests/dashboard.test.ts (it pins parts of the hall's generated head: lang="zh-Hant", no Google Fonts) runs in CI too, in immutable-publications.yml's full `bun test --timeout 15000` step, which finds it by discovery and names it nowhere, so it has no runs entry. The first draft said it ran by hand only, which was wrong. check.mjs is not wired yet: KINGDOM-OS has no root package.json, and the proposal is a bun test (tests/hub-brand.test.ts) that runs `node doors/hub/brand/check.mjs`, which that same step would then run.

Today the hall serves no favicon (/favicon.ico answers 404), no og:image and no theme-color; it declares color-scheme 'dark light' though it has no light scheme, and lang zh-Hant on mostly English copy (review 2026-11-02 §3.1; the head was re-checked in site/dashboard.html at 65c6cf09). The smallest card fix is kingdom-os-hub's media/og-atlas.jpg, 'ready for https://thekingdom.dev/', once its maker is recorded.
